name: Infrared / Low-Light Observation
description: Many security cameras and motion sensors use infrared illumination that is invisible to the naked eye but detectable with IR-capable optics. A handheld IR monocular allows you to map active IR illuminators and identify camera coverage in low-light environments without revealing your position. This is critical for planning after-hours or early-morning entries where IR-based motion detectors are the primary detection mechanism.

blue.det: Difficult to detect — operator uses IR viewer passively; IR illuminator use detectable with IR-sensitive camera.
blue.cm: IR-blocking window film on sensitive areas; conduct after-hours security walks to identify IR camera placements; use IR-opaque barriers around sensitive equipment.
